modules.title: Ophthalmic Foundations & Patient Communication
modules.purpose: Establish foundational ocular terminology, patient-centered communication, privacy, safety, and technician role boundaries.
learning_objectives: Use foundational ophthalmic terminology appropriately.
Communicate respectfully with patients and coworkers.
Protect patient privacy and recognize when to escalate a concern.

technician_may: Perform assigned support tasks under practice policy and supervision.
Document patient-reported information and staff observations accurately.
technician_must_not: Diagnose a patient or independently direct treatment.
stop_repeat_or_escalate: The patient reports an urgent symptom or the technician is uncertain how to proceed.

modules.title: Refraction & Lensometry
modules.purpose: Introduce refractive notation, optical terminology, lens measurement, documentation, and the technician's supervised role.
learning_objectives: Recognize sphere, cylinder, axis, prism, and add notation.
Explain the purpose of refraction and lensometry.
Record measurements accurately and identify questionable results.

technician_may: Perform assigned measurements using practice-approved methods.
Repeat and document measurements according to practice policy.
technician_must_not: Independently prescribe or finalize an eyeglass prescription.
stop_repeat_or_escalate: An unexpected change or equipment error is identified.

modules.title: Tonometry & Intraocular Pressure Measurement
modules.purpose: Teach intraocular pressure measurement, common tonometry methods, infection control, documentation, and reliability factors.
learning_objectives: Explain why intraocular pressure is measured.
Prepare the patient and equipment using approved procedures.
Document the method and result and recognize when to repeat or escalate.

technician_may: Operate an approved tonometer after device-specific training.
Document the method, eye, time, and result.
technician_must_not: Diagnose a condition from a pressure measurement.
Invent emergency thresholds or device settings.
stop_repeat_or_escalate: The measurement is unreliable or cannot be obtained safely.
The result or patient response meets practice-defined escalation criteria.

modules.title: Slit Lamp Examination & Anterior Segment Imaging
modules.purpose: Introduce slit-lamp components, safe positioning, illumination, anterior-segment image acquisition, documentation, and equipment care.
learning_objectives: Identify major slit-lamp controls and their basic purpose.
Prepare and position the patient safely.
Acquire and label images according to practice protocol.

technician_may: Acquire assigned images and describe technical observations.
technician_must_not: Represent online completion as independent examination competency.
stop_repeat_or_escalate: The patient cannot be positioned safely.
The equipment is damaged, unstable, or functioning incorrectly.

modules.title: Retinal Imaging & OCT Interpretation
modules.purpose: Teach safe retinal and OCT image acquisition, quality recognition, basic terminology, and the boundary between technical observation and provider interpretation.
learning_objectives: Prepare the patient and select the assigned imaging protocol.
Recognize common artifacts and poor-quality scans.
Label and save images correctly and escalate uncertainty.

technician_may: Acquire assigned retinal and OCT images.
Recognize and document technical image-quality concerns.
technician_must_not: Independently interpret OCT for treatment decisions.
stop_repeat_or_escalate: Image quality remains unacceptable after approved troubleshooting.
The assigned protocol or laterality is unclear.

modules.title: Visual Field Testing & Interpretation
modules.purpose: Teach visual-field test preparation, patient coaching, reliability monitoring, artifact recognition, documentation, and escalation.
learning_objectives: Prepare and coach the patient for visual-field testing.
Follow the assigned testing strategy and monitor reliability.
Recognize and document factors that may make a test unreliable.

technician_may: Perform the assigned test and monitor reliability indicators.
technician_must_not: Independently alter the provider's testing strategy.
stop_repeat_or_escalate: The patient cannot understand or complete the test reliably.
The order, strategy, lens, or laterality is unclear.

modules.title: Advanced Imaging & Specialized Procedures
modules.purpose: Provide a safe framework for learning practice-approved specialized tests without treating devices or procedures as interchangeable.
learning_objectives: Confirm the order, patient, device, and assigned protocol.
Follow manufacturer and practice instructions.
Document completion and escalate contraindications or uncertainty.

technician_may: Perform a specialized procedure only after procedure-specific training and authorization.
technician_must_not: Invent device settings, contraindications, medication directions, or universal protocols.
stop_repeat_or_escalate: A contraindication, uncertainty, equipment issue, or protocol conflict is identified.

competencies: Separate supervisor validation for each specialized device or procedure

modules.title: Patient Communication & Soft Skills
modules.purpose: Strengthen empathy, plain-language explanations, de-escalation, accessibility, teamwork, and professional boundaries.
learning_objectives: Explain procedures without making unauthorized promises.
Respond professionally to frustration or confusion.
Use teach-back and escalate concerns appropriately.

technician_may: Explain assigned procedures within approved scripts and practice policy.
technician_must_not: Make clinical, financial, or scheduling promises beyond assigned authority.
stop_repeat_or_escalate: The patient requests medical advice or an exception outside the technician's authority.
The interaction becomes threatening or cannot be safely de-escalated.

modules.title: Clinical Documentation & EHR Proficiency
modules.purpose: Teach timely, accurate, objective documentation and safe use of practice systems.
learning_objectives: Document patient statements, observations, actions, and escalation accurately.
Distinguish patient-reported information from staff observations.
Protect credentials and patient information.

technician_may: Document assigned work accurately and correct errors according to practice policy.
technician_must_not: Alter documentation to support a preferred billing level or clinical conclusion.
Share credentials or include real credentials in training.
stop_repeat_or_escalate: A documentation error cannot be corrected using the approved workflow.
Unauthorized access, credential exposure, or a privacy concern is suspected.

modules.title: Professional Development & Career Pathways
modules.purpose: Consolidate professional expectations, continuing learning, competency development, feedback, and career planning.
learning_objectives: Create a supervised professional-development plan.
Distinguish course completion from certification and clinical competency.
Use feedback and reliable continuing-education resources appropriately.

technician_may: Use course completion as evidence of completed education.
Seek supervised practice and additional training.
technician_must_not: Represent the OptiTech certificate as licensure, JCAHPO certification, or proof of independent clinical competency.
stop_repeat_or_escalate: Certification, scope, or eligibility information is unclear or may have changed.
